name: Operational Runbooks & Maintenance
description: Operational Runbooks & Maintenance standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-RUNBOOK applies.

rules.title: Maintain runbooks for repeatable high-impact operational procedures
rules.detail: Deployment recovery, failover, credential rotation, queue replay, data repair and similar actions have concise executable procedures.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Maintain runbooks for repeatable high-impact operational procedures.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Maintain runbooks for repeatable high-impact operational procedures.

rules.title: State prerequisites, permissions and safety checks
rules.detail: Each runbook identifies required access, environment, backups, stop conditions and expected impact before commands/actions.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: State prerequisites, permissions and safety checks.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: State prerequisites, permissions and safety checks.

rules.title: Include verification and rollback
rules.detail: Procedures define how to confirm success and what to do when an intermediate step fails.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Include verification and rollback.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Include verification and rollback.

rules.title: Prefer copy-safe parameterized commands
rules.detail: Commands clearly mark variables/environment and avoid examples that could accidentally target production or expose secrets.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prefer copy-safe parameterized commands.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prefer copy-safe parameterized commands.

rules.title: Link observability and escalation references
rules.detail: Runbooks point to relevant dashboards/log queries/alerts and contacts rather than relying on operator memory.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Link observability and escalation references.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Link observability and escalation references.

rules.title: Test and update runbooks
rules.detail: Exercise critical runbooks periodically and revise them after incidents, platform changes or failed execution.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test and update runbooks.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test and update runbooks.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-RUNBOOK applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Operational Runbooks & Maintenance to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Operational Runbooks & Maintenance is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Operational Runbooks & Maintenance failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
